accepted.sentence: Oceanographers use crewed deep-diving vehicles to collect seabed sediment cores, preserving clues about past climates and ocean conditions.
Marine biologists observe deep-sea coral communities in place, helping assess their vulnerability before fishing or development begins.
Offshore wind operators use crewed underwater vehicles to inspect turbine foundations and moorings for damage after storms.
Commercial salvage teams send crewed vehicles to locate and recover valuable cargo from wrecks lying beyond diver reach.
After deep-water aircraft crashes, search teams may use crewed vehicles to locate recorders and assist recovery investigations.
Documentary teams use crewed deep-diving vehicles to film deep-ocean wildlife at depths inaccessible to ordinary scuba divers.
Geologists use crewed vehicles to inspect seafloor landslides, documenting terrain that may pose tsunami hazards to coastal communities.
Researchers pilot crewed deep-diving vehicles around seamounts to observe fish behavior, informing assessments of vulnerable fisheries.
